clue.text: Stiffener for fabric of structure to right of street

indicators.note: in an across entry, being to the right of a piece means coming after it

parts.note: an arch is a curved supporting structure

explanation.surface: A builder's phrase about a stiffening member placed to the right of a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fabric' and 'structure' suggest building work, but the definition is laundry: starch stiffens cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Starch is the powder or spray used to make cloth stiff, so it is literally a fabric stiffener.

clue.text: Follow famous Irish playwright around party

indicators.note: the playwright's name is placed around the party word, holding it inside

parts.note: George Bernard Shaw, the Dublin-born dramatist
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: Someone trails a celebrated Irish dramatist round a social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone is to trail them closely and secretly, a verb synonym for tail or pursue.

clue.text: Say a rich plot's needing development, like properties of the stars

indicators.note: the letters still need working up into their final shape, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A rich storyline needs fleshing out, perhaps for a film about celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stars' in the surface hints at film stars; in the definition they are celestial.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrophysics studies the physical nature of stars, so the adjective describes stellar properties.

clue.text: First among chefs to be very fond of a piece of garlic

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the following word is used

parts.note: to love is to be very fond of

explanation.surface: The head cook adores a bit of garlic.
explanation.definitionFit: A clove is one of the separable segments that make up a bulb of garlic.

clue.text: Company returning mongrels is found to exist

indicators.note: coming back means the abbreviation is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: curs are mongrel dogs

explanation.surface: A firm sending back stray dogs turns out to be real.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that occurs happens or is present, so it is found to be in existence.

clue.text: Two forms of Assam, say, served by upper-class French house

indicators.note: the tea words come first and are followed by the upper-class letter

parts.note: Assam is a kind of tea, and tea is also called cha, so the two names CHA and TEA

explanation.surface: Posh people pour two kinds of Indian tea in a grand French home.
explanation.walkthrough: Assam is a tea-growing region of India; CHA is a colloquial British word for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A chateau is a French country mansion or castle, a grand French residence.

clue.text: Dull local is led by university wise men

indicators.note: the local word comes last, with the others ahead of it

parts.note: uni is an informal shortening of university
the Magi were the wise men of the Nativity
a native is a local person

explanation.surface: A boring pub regular trails behind some academic sages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' looks like the British pub sense but here means a resident.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lacking imagination is dull and uninspired, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Run through botanic gardens amid heads of some English roses

indicators.note: the gardens' name sits in the middle of the three opening letters
the opening letters of the next three words are taken

parts.note: Kew Gardens in London are the Royal Botanic Gardens

explanation.surface: A walk through Kew among English roses.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening letters give SER, and KEW goes inside after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: To skewer something is to pierce or run it through with a pointed rod.

clue.text: Reliable writer I rubbish? I have

parts.note: an author is a writer
tat is cheap worthless stuff
contracted to I've, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A dependable author wonders whether their own work is rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: An authoritative source is one that can be trusted as accurate, hence reliable.

clue.text: In Channel Islands, inept manoeuvring just beginning

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: moving the letters about means rearranging them

explanation.surface: Clumsy boat handling in Jersey or Guernsey waters is just starting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvring' rearranges INEPT into PIENT. The Channel Islands are the British islands off Normandy.
explanation.definitionFit: Incipient means in an initial stage, just starting to develop.

clue.text: Toxic gas round area

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O
a zone is an area

explanation.surface: Poisonous fumes encircle a district.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone, a form of oxygen, is poisonous to breathe at ground level.

clue.text: Burn wooden case outside empty emporium

indicators.note: the case is placed outside, around the shell of the shop word

parts.note: a crate is a wooden packing case

indicators.note: emptying a word removes its insides, leaving the outer letters

explanation.surface: Setting fire to a packing box outside a deserted store.
explanation.definitionFit: To cremate is to burn a body to ashes, a specific sense of burning.

clue.text: Hate picture designed so as to have a healing effect

definitions.note: adjective sense: having a healing effect

indicators.note: laid out to a new design, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: An abhorrent image was made deliberately to help people recover.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapeutic treatments are those that help cure illness or restore wellbeing.

clue.text: Consult text again about temperature for remoulded tyre

indicators.note: the rereading word goes about, surrounding, the temperature letter

parts.note: to reread is to read a text once more

explanation.surface: Reading the manual again about the heat needed to remould a tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: A retread is a worn tyre given a new moulded tread, so a remoulded tyre.

clue.text: Good accommodation for those looking after horses

parts.note: rooms are lodging or accommodation

explanation.surface: Decent lodgings provided for stable hands.
explanation.definitionFit: Grooms are stable workers who brush, feed and care for horses.

clue.text: British bird of prey on which Darwin worked

parts.note: an eagle is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A British raptor that Darwin studied.
explanation.walkthrough: Darwin made his famous voyage as naturalist aboard the survey ship HMS Beagle.
explanation.definitionFit: HMS Beagle was the ship on which Charles Darwin sailed and worked as naturalist.

clue.text: Ribbon development of street naught will interrupt

indicators.note: the nothing letter breaks into the reworked street letters
developing the word reworks its letters into a new order

parts.note: naught, nothing, is the letter O

explanation.surface: Planners object to ribbon development along a street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'development of' rearranges STREET into RSETTE, and O goes in after the R. Ribbon development is housing strung along a main road.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosette is a rose-shaped knot of ribbon awarded as a prize.

clue.text: Work very hard to put money aside when about fifty

indicators.note: the saving word goes about, around, the fifty letter

parts.note: to save is to put money aside
L is the Roman numeral fifty

explanation.surface: Toiling hard to build savings at around fifty years old.
explanation.definitionFit: To slave away is to toil exhaustingly, like a forced labourer.

clue.text: Point seen in last agenda

indicators.note: the letters can be spotted inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An item noticed on the previous meeting's agenda.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage is a point or step reached in a process.

clue.text: Gold strong box has sailor planning behind the scenes

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a chest is a strong box
a rating is an ordinary seaman

explanation.surface: A sailor with a treasure chest of gold plots quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestrating means arranging or masterminding events discreetly, like a conductor unseen by the action.

clue.text: Therefore tops must be three-dimensional figures

parts.note: so means therefore
lids are tops of containers

explanation.surface: A logical argument that lids must have depth.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry solids are shapes with length, breadth and depth, like cubes and spheres.

clue.text: Bad cut given by key

indicators.note: the key letter is supplied after the cutting word

parts.note: to sever is to cut
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A nasty gash from a sharp key.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe, as in a severe illness or storm, means very bad or serious.
